import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict[str, pd.DataFrame]) -> dict[str, pd.DataFrame]:
    payments = inputs["payments"].copy()

    amount = payments["amount"]
    currency = payments["currency"]
    country = payments["country"]

    valid_currencies = {"USD", "EUR", "GBP"}

    # Rule masks, evaluated in order; each later mask excludes rows
    # already caught by an earlier rule.
    mask_r1 = amount.isna()

    mask_r2 = (~mask_r1) & (amount <= 0)

    not_valid_ccy = ~currency.isin(valid_currencies)
    mask_r3 = (~mask_r1) & (~mask_r2) & not_valid_ccy

    mask_r4 = (~mask_r1) & (~mask_r2) & (~mask_r3) & country.isna()

    reject_mask = mask_r1 | mask_r2 | mask_r3 | mask_r4
    clean_mask = ~reject_mask

    # Build rejects output
    rejects = payments.loc[reject_mask].copy()
    reason_code = pd.Series(index=rejects.index, dtype="object")
    reason_code.loc[mask_r1.reindex(rejects.index, fill_value=False)] = "AMT_NULL"
    reason_code.loc[mask_r2.reindex(rejects.index, fill_value=False)] = "AMT_NONPOS"
    reason_code.loc[mask_r3.reindex(rejects.index, fill_value=False)] = "CCY_INVALID"
    reason_code.loc[mask_r4.reindex(rejects.index, fill_value=False)] = "CTRY_NULL"
    rejects["reason_code"] = reason_code

    # Build clean output
    clean = payments.loc[clean_mask].copy()
    clean["amount"] = clean["amount"].round(2)

    payments_clean = clean.reset_index(drop=True)
    payments_rejects = rejects.reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "payments_clean": payments_clean,
        "payments_rejects": payments_rejects,
    }
